evaluation.gate_failure_reason: citation_accuracy 0.8333... < 0.9 -- one golden-dataset case (password-policy query) correctly retrieves the right document as top-1 but the cross-encoder reranker's absolute confidence for that pairing is genuinely low (0.0074 vs 0.99+ for passing cases), so the system abstains rather than answers. Not fixed by lowering the qualifying-evidence threshold, which would also admit genuinely irrelevant low-scored results -- see docs/release-gate/PROGRESS.md.
evaluation.note: First real run against a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, configured post-v1.0.0 tag. Surfaced and fixed 3 real evaluation-harness defects (judge evidence placeholder, prompt-injection false-positive substring check in two places, citation_accuracy not handling correct abstention) -- see PROGRESS.md.

performance_baseline.note: ask_ms reflects the FakeLLMProvider fallback path (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY configured in this environment), not a real generation call -- see model.generation_llm and evaluation.known_gap. retrieve_ms p99/max is a single real outlier (7585ms against a 175-334ms baseline), not re-run to smooth it out -- see docs/release-gate/PROGRESS.md, Sprint 15, for the honest read on why.
